title.value: Upgrading and Gravelling of Bhanu-Satiswara Road (3.2 km) including Side Drains and Slab Culverts, Bhanu-6, Tanahun
title.quote: Name of Work: Upgrading and Gravelling of Bhanu-Satiswara Road (3.2 km) including Side Drains and Slab Culverts, Bhanu-6, Tanahun

buyer.value: Bhanu Municipality, Office of the Municipal Executive
buyer.quote: Bhanu Municipality, Office of the Municipal Executive, invites electronic bids

scope.value: Gravelling of a 3.2 km road with side drains and four slab culverts.
scope.quote: earthwork in road formation, 150 mm gravel sub-base and base course over 3.2 km

deadline.quote: Bids must be submitted electronically through the PPMO e-GP system on or before 12:00 hours on 2083-08-05 B.S. (2026-11-21 A.D.).

bid_security.quote: Bidders must submit a bid security of Rs. 4,46,000/- in the form of a bank guarantee

bid_security_validity.quote: valid until 2083-12-15 B.S., or a cash deposit to the municipality's deposit account.

bid_validity.value: 90 days from the bid submission deadline
bid_validity.quote: Bid validity: 90 days from the bid submission deadline.

bid_doc_fee.quote: after paying a non-refundable fee of Rs. 3,000/- to the municipality's revenue account

min_avg_turnover.quote: Average annual construction turnover of the best three years within the last five fiscal years of at least Rs. 1,50,00,000.

min_similar_contract_value.quote: of value not less than Rs. 60,00,000 in a single contract within the last five fiscal years.

jv_quote: Bidders may form a joint venture of not more than three partners.

required_docs.source_quote: Valid firm/company registration certificate and construction licence of Class "D" or above, renewed for F/Y 2083/84.
